This leaf is found chiefly in frigid climates, especially in glaciers and snowfields, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Jojojopo leaves are applied to frostbitten areas. They treat cold-induced injuries and restore 2–20 concussion hits lost in this way. The plant grows among snow and ice, where it remains very hard to find even for travellers accustomed to winter conditions.
